faq.question: Does the hotel provide free Wi-Fi?
faq.answer: Yes. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel.

faq.question: Is parking available?
faq.answer: Yes. Complimentary parking is available for hotel guests.

faq.question: Does the hotel have a swimming pool?
faq.answer: Yes. PRASHIV has an outdoor swimming pool.

faq.question: Is breakfast available?
faq.answer: Yes. Breakfast is available as an optional add-on for ₹500 per adult per night. Breakfast is served from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Does the restaurant have vegetarian food?
faq.answer: Yes. The restaurant offers a variety of vegetarian dishes.

faq.question: Does the restaurant serve non-vegetarian food?
faq.answer: Yes. Chicken, fish, mutton and egg-based dishes are available.

faq.question: Is room service available?
faq.answer: Yes. Room service is available from 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM.

faq.question: Does the hotel have a gym?
faq.answer: Yes. The fitness center is open from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

faq.question: Can I request airport transfer?
faq.answer: Yes. Airport transfer can be arranged through the hotel, subject to availability and additional charges.
